placeholders.name: PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE
placeholders.description: Setup architecture token, derived from the qualified media reference.

placeholders.name: UI_LANGUAGE
placeholders.description: Language tag, derived from the qualified media reference.

placeholders.name: IMAGE_INDEX
placeholders.description: Image index within the media, derived from the qualified media reference.

placeholders.name: COMPUTER_NAME
placeholders.description: Build VM name during construction. Generalization removes it, so it never reaches the image.

placeholders.name: TIME_ZONE
placeholders.description: Windows time zone identifier for the build, stated rather than left to the installer.

placeholders.name: BUILD_USERNAME
placeholders.description: The account setup configures and the build communicator authenticates as.

placeholders.name: ADMINISTRATOR_PASSWORD
placeholders.description: Build administrator password. Injected at runtime, never committed, and disabled or rotated before sealing.
